spec.description: Kingspan AIR-CELL Glareshield is an Australian-made thermo reflective anti-glare insulation designed to combat radiant, convective, and conductive heat transfer. It provides a 3-in-1 insulation, vapour barrier, and reflective barrier solution specifically engineered for roof applications. Built with a cross-linked closed-cell insulation core sandwiched between reflective foil facings, it is water-resistant, non-allergenic, and CodeMark-certified for NCC compliance.
features: 3-in-1 insulation, vapour barrier and reflective barrier

technical.value: 6 dB(A) noise reduction through an attic roof

spec.fire: Flammability Index ≤ 5 (Low) to AS 1530.2; Suitable for BAL Low - 40 as roof sarking under AS 3959
spec.compliance: AS/NZS 4859.1:2018, AS/NZS 4200.1:2017, CodeMark Certified for NCC Compliance, AS 1530.2
spec.sustainability: Fibre-free core, non-allergenic, non-irritant, zero ODP, low VOC
install: Roll out Kingspan AIR-CELL Glareshield perpendicular to rafters or purlins with anti-glare face facing up
Ensure a maximum 25mm overlap into the gutter
Allow a nominal 40mm sag between battens/purlins to create reflective airspaces
Overlap joins by 150mm if untaped, or 50mm when joins are taped
End joins should be overlapped by 600mm if untaped or rafter spacing
Tape joins with 72mm wide Kingspan AIR-CELL reinforced foil tape
Fix sheeting by screwing through the insulation to purlins or fix battens over rafters
Ensure at least 100mm clearance from hot flues, exhaust vents, and recessed lighting
Where purlin/rafter spacing exceeds 2.4m, install safety wire mesh first to support the insulation
selection_checklist: Confirm roof structure (metal deck vs tiled roof)
Verify framing spacing (support mesh required if framing exceeds 2.4m)
Confirm required system Total R-value for climate zone
Check bushfire attack level (BAL) compliance requirements
Ensure anti-glare side faces upward during installation
limitations: Can be damaged by intense heat above 105°C; avoid flame, blow torches, welders, and cutting tools
Foil facings are electrically conductive; avoid contact with uninsulated electrical wiring
Smooth aluminium facing can become slippery underfoot when wet
Non-load bearing; do not walk directly on unsupported insulation
Must not be stored in direct contact with wet cement, lime or alkaline materials

problem_keywords: rain drumming noise on corrugated iron
meeting roof R-value in low pitch roof
use_cases: installing over purlins under residential metal corrugated roofs with anti-glare facing up
retrofitting under industrial and shed metal deck roofs to cut radiant heat gain and manage condensation
laying beneath residential tiled roofs to serve as combined radiant barrier and water-resistant sarking
providing up to 6 dB(A) rain noise attenuation and thermal comfort in cathedral or low-pitch roof spaces
not_for: direct impact floor underlay beneath timber or tiles
direct application against surfaces exceeding 105°C continuous heat
retrieval.rag_summary: Kingspan AIR-CELL Glareshield is an Australian-made, CodeMark-certified 3-in-1 thermo-reflective insulation, water barrier, and vapour barrier engineered specifically for metal and tiled roof applications. Formulated with a closed-cell cross-linked polyolefin foam core faced with reflective foil and a patented upper anti-glare coating, it reflects radiant heat while mitigating rain noise by up to 6 dB(A) and controlling condensation. Rated Extra Heavy Duty with a Flammability Index ≤ 5 (suitable for bushfire zones up to BAL-40 as roof sarking under AS 3959), it provides a fibre-free, non-allergenic, and moisture-resistant thermal solution across residential, commercial, and shed roofs.
